source_quotes: we don't record failures and move on all failures are to be fixed
overlap_check: Built-in method_22 (persistent cache parity) and method_23 (idempotency check durability) cover cache-versus-store drift and restart safety of checks; this covers the write path itself. Related to 31 and 38. New.

payload.name: Writes That Matter Are Durable, Ordered and Never Disable Their Sink
payload.description: State, ledgers, evidence logs and snapshots are written with one attempt now and an ordered retry until they land. A failing disk is shown, not hidden, and never turns a log off.

principles.name: A lost write is a lost fact
principles.description: Logs and ledgers are evidence; a failed append that is ignored deletes part of the record.

principles.name: Say the limits
principles.description: A queue held in memory is lost if the process dies while the disk still refuses it; that is stated, not hidden.

heuristics.condition: a write is wrapped so that its error is ignored
heuristics.action: route it through the durable helper or return the error to a caller that handles it

heuristics.condition: the first failure of a sink disables it for the process
heuristics.action: remove the disable; the sink recovers when the disk does

decision_rules.name: Retry in order until written
decision_rules.condition: a write matters, such as state, a ledger, a log or a snapshot
decision_rules.outcome: make one synchronous attempt, then queue per path and retry in order with spacing that grows and holds; no give-up, no cap, no drop, no rotation of evidence logs

decision_rules.name: Make a stall visible
decision_rules.outcome: warn on the first failure and on recovery, emit stalled and recovered events, and expose counters and the last error per path on a status route

decision_rules.name: Backup before overwrite
decision_rules.condition: a file is about to be overwritten
decision_rules.outcome: let the backup write fail the operation first; nothing is overwritten without its copy

decision_rules.name: Snapshot before mutate
decision_rules.condition: a container update or delete needs a restore point
decision_rules.outcome: make the mutation wait until the snapshot exists; a container that fails to load is snapshotted from its raw bytes so the change can proceed with a real restore point

decision_rules.name: Read what is pending
decision_rules.condition: a read-modify-write works on a file with queued writes
decision_rules.outcome: read through the helper that returns the newest not-yet-applied snapshot, not stale disk bytes

decision_rules.name: List the exceptions
decision_rules.condition: a write is not routed through the helper
decision_rules.outcome: record why: the logging sink itself would recurse, a file needs restrictive permissions, or the caller already handles the returned error
